{{Top}}
[[File:Trade_Federation_turbolasers.png|thumb|right|250px|Quad turbolaser batteries on a pre-[[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]-era [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]]]]
A '''quad turbolaser cannon''' was a heavier version of the [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad laser cannon]] and at least one variety was produced by [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]].

==Characteristics==
Quad turbolasers were magnitudes more powerful than the quad laser cannons, which were installed on many lesser warships and freighters.

Weapons of this kind were used aboard a variety of [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], like the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]],<ref name="E1ICS">''[[Star Wars: Episode I Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> the [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]],<ref name="ROTSICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]],<ref name="AOTCICS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] and the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="TOS&VC5">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 5|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 5]]</ref>
They were also utilized as part of ground artillery by many factions, along with one- or two-barreled turbolaser cannons.<ref name="SWE:PW">''[[Star Wars: Empire: Princess... Warrior]]''</ref>
